description: Initiative 0002 Slice 3: commitment parsing baseline for pack_01_clean producing B-I requirements and B-II exceptions payloads that match truth key fields with lockable citations and fail-closed verification.

userStories.title: Extract B-I requirements tracker (clean pack)
userStories.description: Extract Schedule B-I requirements into list_payload_v0 with stable item_id and item-level citation_ids, matching truth key fields with zero false positives.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_01_clean, extracted requirements item count equals truth item count.
For pack_01_clean, every extracted item has the correct truth item number and required key fields as defined by the comparator.
Precision rule: no extra items not present in truth by item number.
Each item has item-level citation_ids that lock and verify; no header-only citations for item content.

userStories.title: Extract B-II exceptions table (clean pack)
userStories.description: Extract Schedule B-II exceptions into list_payload_v0 with stable item_id and item-level citation_ids, matching truth key fields and normalising instrument refs deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_01_clean, extracted exceptions item count equals truth item count.
For pack_01_clean, every extracted exception has the correct item number and required key fields as defined by the comparator.
Instrument references are normalised to a single canonical form (declared once and reused).
Each exception item has item-level citation_ids that lock and verify.
